faqs.a:
The following words, terms and phrases, when used in this article, shall have the
               meanings ascribed to them in this section, except where the context clearly indicates
               a different meaning:
Board
means any appointive body, board, commission, or authority of the city which the
               city appoints the entire membership and which is empowered by delegation from the
               city council or ordinance to exercise a governmental function. The word "board" shall
               specifically include the city council, planning commission, the board of adjustment,
               the liquor licensing authority, and the building code advisory board, but shall not
               include advisory or ad hoc committees or Internal Revenue Code, § 501(C)(3) boards
               except to the extent a board member is otherwise a city officer.
Board member
means a regular or alternate member of a board irrespective of election or appointment
               to such board.
Business entity
means any corporation, general or limited partnership, sole proprietorship (including
               a private consultant operation), joint venture, unincorporated association or firm,
               institution, trust, foundation, or other organization, whether organized for profit
               or not.
City
means the incorporated home rule City of Arvada, Colorado.
City council
means the city council of the City of Arvada, Colorado.
Confidential information
means all information which may lawfully be designated confidential, whether verbal,
               written, or electronically recorded, which is at the time not available to the general
               public under applicable laws, ordinances and regulations, or which has otherwise been
               designated as confidential by the city council, the city manager or the city attorney.
               Confidential information subsequently disclosed, without violating this Code, to outside
               parties shall no longer be confidential information. The city may adopt rules and
               a policy pertaining to confidential information discussed or distributed at executive
               sessions.
Councilmember
means any member of the city council of the City of Arvada, Colorado.
Disclose
means to bring to the attention to make known a financial interest or conflict of
               interest.
Disinterested third person
shall mean a person who possess the experience and qualifications to investigate
               and/or conduct a determination process pursuant to this article and who has no current
               personal or business association with the city, individual making a complaint or allegation
               under this article, the officer subject to an allegation under this article or any
               other officer of the city.
Employee
means a person who labors or provides services for the city and who is paid a wage
               or salary for such labor or services, but does not include any member of city council
               or any person appointed by the city council to serve on any city board, commission,
               committee, agency, or authority.
Family
means an officer's spouse; natural, step, or adopted child; mother, father, sister,
               brother, grandparent, mother-in-law, father-in-law; or any other relative or dependent
               residing in the same household as the officer.
Financial interest
means a pecuniary interest, the nature of which is either:
(1)
Ownership interest in a business entity;
(2)
Creditor interest in a business entity;
(3)
An employment or prospective employment for which negotiations have begun;
(4)
Ownership in real or personal property;
(5)
A loan or any other debtor interest; or
(6)
A directorship or officership in a business entity.
Governmental function
means participation by discussion, vote, or other action as a member of a board,
               whether in a quasi-judicial, legislative, rulemaking or administrative action.
Interest
means a direct substantial pecuniary (which shall include real and personal property
               and cash) benefit accruing to an officer as a result of that officer's official participation
               in a governmental function except for such actions which by their terms or the substance
               of their provisions confer an opportunity or right to realize the accrual of a similar
               benefit generally to all other persons or property similarly situated.
Malfeasance
shall mean an act or failure to act committed by an officer in the course of his
               official duties which is unlawful and against the interests of the city.
Misconduct
shall mean any willful and unlawful behavior by an officer in relation to the duties
               of his office.
Officer
means any person who is elected to office or appointed by city council, including
               board members, the city manager, city attorney and municipal judges.
Official body
means the city council and any appointive body empowered by delegation from city
               council or ordinance to exercise a governmental function including; planning commission,
               board of adjustment, liquor authority. However, it does not include ad hoc committees
               or advisory committees.
Order
or
directive
shall mean, when used within the context of council to city employees interaction,
               to instruct a city employee to take some action within the scope of their employment.
               Requests and similar inquiries of department heads made within the provisions of the
               Charter or any other employee as may be delegated by the city manager shall not be
               interpreted as orders or directives.
Pecuniary benefit
means a benefit in the form of money, property, or commercial interests.
Person
means the singular or plural of any natural person, entity, corporation, partnership,
               association or authorized agent thereof.
(Code 1981, § 2-52; Ord. No. 3088, § 2, 6-27-1994)
